# Pass criteria

## MUST
- Place the team at **Scattered** (stage two), not Operating or Compounding.
- Lead with a one-line verdict that states the stage and names the "Operating" guess as too high.
- Refuse to let the tool purchases (Figma AI, Cursor) or the all-hands mandate lift the placement — name that tools bought and a mandate are intent and spend, not practice.
- Name the missing gate as **Decision** — a shared bar for what to prototype and what good looks like — not more tools.
- Return a belief-vs-practice contrast and point at the concrete untranslated places for this team: the two designers' private experiments, the absent shared method, work shipping unmeasured.
- Ask exactly one plain-language sharpening question (whether it is really just the two designers on side work, or most of the team generating real deliverables).

## MUST NOT
- Return Operating or Compounding.
- Treat the tool inventory or the mandate as evidence of adoption that earns a stage.
- Prescribe buying more tools as the fix.
- Hand back a general questionnaire, or the sharpening question with no placement.
- Bury the stage verdict inside the body instead of leading with it.
